description:
Cast Stream of Life using the convoke ability from Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Infirmary Healer.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Infirmary Healer, which enters prepared.
Resolve Stream of Life.
Repeat.
